description: This file defines internal classes and functions for non-secure random number generation within the Abseil library, including a seed sequence class and a thread-unique URBG base class.

classes.name: RandenPoolSeedSeq
classes.description: A seed sequence class that fills buffers using the RandenPool entropy source.

classes.name: NonsecureURBGBase
classes.description: A template class providing a thread-unique, non-secure random number generator seeded by a seed sequence.

methods.name: generate_impl
methods.description: Internal method to generate random data into a buffer, optimized for contiguous or non-contiguous memory.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Public method to generate random data into a range specified by iterators.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Returns a random number from the underlying URBG.

methods.name: discard
methods.description: Discards a specified number of random values.

methods.name: min
methods.description: Returns the minimum value of the URBG.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Returns the maximum value of the URBG.
